name: Parallel Distributed 2D Texture Slicing
aliases: Parallel Distributed 2D Texture Slicing (Bethel et al.)
definition: An engine with parallel distributed implementation for visualizing large, remotely located, time-varying, adaptive, hierarchical scientific data that won't fit on a workstation. It uses a 2D texture-based method with axis-aligned slicing to achieve interactive transformation on low-end workstations.
